to C$8M from C$5M, with proceeds to fund exploration at its South Bullfrog gold project in Nevada and general working capital.

The offering now comprises up to 40M units at C$0.20 each, with each unit consisting of one common share and half a warrant. Each whole warrant will be exercisable at C$0.30 a share for 24 months from closing.
The financing is expected to close on or about September 29 in one or more tranches, subject to regulatory and TSX Venture Exchange approvals.

The company holds a 100% interest in the project, comprising 488 BLM claims covering about 10,050 acres in Nevada’s Beatty District. Eligible finders may receive up to 6% in cash and 6% in non-transferable warrants.

title: Bullfrog Gold raises private placement target to C$8M
